clips.title: The story
paras: Milly Osworth records her rescued grape harvest for Northshire Abbey. She writes a manifest of the yield recovered from Defias thieves, then sends it to Brother Neals so the brotherhood can replenish its wine stores.

Northshire Valley's soil and orchards have long supported local food and the abbey's wine. When thieves and bandits seized the eastern fields, they cut off the abbey's supply of grapes and food. With the harvest recovered from the occupied fields, Milly Osworth records the yield in a manifest.

Brother Neals oversees food and drink at Northshire Abbey. He is known for sampling Northshire's vintages in the quiet of the bell tower. Brigands still threaten the gates, but fresh grapes give the brotherhood a moment to toast the Light and take heart.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that my crop is saved, take this Grape Manifest to Brother Neals. He manages the store of food and drink in Northshire, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.
You'll find Brother Neals in the abbey, in the bell tower... Where he likes to taste his wine.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look to be in fine spirits! Come! Have a seat, and have a drink!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh my! Milly's grapes have been saved! When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!
And through your bravery, we now have grapes for more wine! May the Light bless you, friend, and keep you safe!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
